description: Evals for the check-bash-read PreToolUse hook

evals.name: cat-large-file
evals.reason: Plain cat on large file — should block

evals.name: cat-small-file
evals.reason: Small file — not worth delegating

evals.name: cat-with-flag
evals.reason: cat with -n flag — should still block

evals.name: head-large-file
evals.reason: head on large file — should block

evals.name: head-with-count
evals.reason: head -100 — still a bulk read, block

evals.name: tail-large-file
evals.reason: tail on large file — should block

evals.name: less-large-file
evals.reason: less on large file — should block

evals.name: cat-pipe
evals.reason: Piped command — targeted read

evals.name: cat-redirect
evals.reason: Redirect — copying file, not reading into context

evals.name: non-read-command
evals.reason: Not a file read command

evals.name: grep-command
evals.reason: grep is a targeted search — not caught

evals.name: cat-quoted-path
evals.reason: Quoted path — should still be caught

evals.name: cat-nonexistent
evals.reason: File doesn't exist — let Bash handle the error

evals.name: empty-command
evals.reason: Empty command — pass through

evals.name: missing-command-field
evals.reason: No command field — pass through

evals.name: more-large-file
evals.reason: more on large file — only regex-matched command without coverage

evals.name: head-n-space-count
evals.reason: Parser bug: -n and 5 are separate args, 5 is treated as file path — file '5' won't exist so allow

evals.name: bash-lc-wrapped-cat
evals.reason: Codex and Gemini hand the shell a `bash -lc` string — unwrap it before matching

evals.name: sh-c-wrapped-cat
evals.reason: same wrapper, plain sh and single quotes

evals.name: argv-array-command
evals.reason: some hosts pass argv as an array, not a string

evals.name: wrapped-pipe-allowed
evals.reason: unwrapping must not lose the pipe that makes it targeted

evals.name: sed-range-allowed
evals.reason: a line range is already a targeted read

evals.name: cmd-key-fallback
evals.reason: a host that names the field cmd is still gated

evals.name: no-jq-fails-open
evals.reason: without jq the gate cannot parse its input: fail open and warn, never block everything

evals.name: rtk-proxy-cat-large
evals.reason: rtk proxy runs the command raw, so a prefixed whole-file read is still a whole-file read

evals.name: rtk-proxy-cat-small
evals.reason: a small file through rtk proxy is not worth delegating

evals.name: rtk-proxy-piped
evals.reason: an rtk-prefixed piped read is targeted, not a read into context

evals.name: rtk-read-large
evals.reason: rtk read is a filtered cat: the corpus still lands in context, so it is gated

evals.name: sed-range-whole-file
evals.reason: A range as long as the file is a whole-file read however it is spelled; the sed advice must not be a loophole

evals.name: sed-range-to-eof
evals.reason: 1,$p is unbounded by construction

evals.name: sed-range-quoted-wide
evals.reason: Double-quoted range is the same range

evals.name: sed-range-small-file
evals.reason: A wide range over a small file still prints little; blocking it would be noise

evals.name: sed-range-narrow-large
evals.reason: A real bounded section is the sanctioned targeted read
